# Guides

Practical guides for working with Oyster beyond the API reference.

- **[oyster-cli Quick Start](/oyster/cli)**: command-line tool for managing
  buckets, blobs, and keys
- **[AWS SDK Examples](/oyster/aws-sdk)**: full workflows in Python (boto3) and
  JavaScript (AWS SDK v3)
- **[Content Addressing](/oyster/content-addressing)**: how blob IDs,
  deduplication, and reference-counted deletion work
- **[Blob Lifecycle](/oyster/blob-lifecycle)**: expiration, automatic renewal,
  and the extension service
- **[Pearl Master-Seed Rotation](/oyster/key-rotation)**: operator runbook for
  moving accounts onto a new master seed (`oysterd keys`)
